name: Book Customer Care Callback
description: Hands the customer to a person by booking a callback from a Brightvale Electric Customer Care specialist, or a Medical Priority callback. Use when the customer asks to talk to a person, is upset, needs a payment plan or claim help, or relies on powered medical equipment. Only the phone number is required. For Medical Priority set medical_priority to yes and preferred_time to as soon as possible, and do not ask for a time; the Medical Priority team calls within about 15 minutes. Always remind medical customers to call 911 if anyone is in danger.
samples:
I want to talk to a real person
Can someone call me back?
Book a callback for tomorrow at 10 AM
My dad uses an oxygen concentrator and our power is out
I need help setting up a payment plan, can someone call me?
Connect me with an agent

vars.phone: Phone number the specialist should call. Ask for it if not given.
vars.preferred_time: When the customer wants the call, in their words. If they have no preference, or for Medical Priority, use: as soon as possible. Do not ask for a time for Medical Priority.
vars.reason: Short summary of why the customer needs a person, written from the conversation. Do not ask.
vars.medical_priority: yes if someone at the address relies on powered medical equipment or refrigerated medicine, otherwise no. Infer it from the conversation.

test.reason: Father uses oxygen concentrator, power out
